description: This file contains the implementation of BedrockFilesConfig class and related methods for handling file uploads, transformations, and interactions with AWS S3 and Bedrock-specific logic within a machine learning or LLM project. It provides utilities for transforming file content, generating S3 object URLs, signing requests, and converting between OpenAI and Bedrock batch formats.

classes.name: BedrockFilesConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for handling Bedrock file uploads, validation, URL generation, and format transformations within AWS S3 context, extending AWS-specific and file-specific base classes.

classes.name: BedrockJsonlFilesTransformation
classes.description: Helper class that provides methods to transform OpenAI JSONL file contents into Bedrock batch format for processing.
